messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: Glad to see this circle set up for raw-milk producers in our region. We have been running into consistent moisture variance in the early autumn wheels as the pastures shift.

messages.author: hannah.ellison.101028@cloverholtcheesemaking.example
messages.text: Same here Jing, the transition from clover to dried forage always catches our wash-rind batches off guard. Are people still planning to attend the virtual symposium sessions next month?

messages.author: amelia.tarleton.100487@lakemail.example
messages.text: We are keeping our fingers crossed for the in-person conference this summer. Trying to calibrate our press pressures without being able to compare notes face to face has been tough.

messages.author: damien.lambert.102240@kestrelmoorcreamery.example
messages.text: Conference was well worth the trip. Our make room has been running at full capacity since we got back and the salt absorption rates have stabilized nicely.

messages.author: giulia.almeida.100449@grunewaldfarmstead.example
messages.text: We are looking at expanding our aging cave space before winter sets in. Has anyone here worked with local contractors on humidity control units recently?

messages.author: charlotte.paxton.100935@norgaarddaughtersfine.example
messages.text: Staffing has been our biggest bottleneck this season, but the quality of the raw milk coming in from Oleg's herd has been exceptionally consistent.

messages.author: damien.janvierarnaud.102415@ashbysonsdairysupply.example
messages.text: Thanks Charlotte. We adjusted the grain mix slightly in January to protect butterfat levels through the cold snap, which seems to have helped everyone's make sheets.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: With the raw-milk aging rule updates coming down from ICF staff, we should set up a working call to review our documentation practices.

messages.author: hannah.ellison.101028@cloverholtcheesemaking.example
messages.text: That is a great idea Jing. Traceability logs are taking up so much of the afternoon now, so comparing our record templates would save everyone time.

messages.author: calvin.mabry.101748@splitashcheeseshop.example
messages.text: From the retail side, the newer aged batches coming out of this group are holding up brilliantly in the case. Let me know when you schedule that call so I can join.
